title: Business Growth Strategy

description.content: We work with CEOs and founders to develop business growth strategies based on the choices of 'where to play' and 'how to win.' Our approach combines cutting edge strategic frameworks, creativity, and design thinking to create actionable strategies that help firms win in the market.

heading: Our approach is based on Roger L. Martin's 'Playing to Win' strategy framework,  honed over two and a half decades of successful strategy development and implementation. Key elements of the process include the following:

consulting.content: Creating a shared sense of 'Where are we today?'
Co-creating a 'winning aspiration' for the business
Developing management systems to nurture these abilities
Creating OKRs to translate strategy into practical business actions
Learning from implementation and sharpening the strategy

title: Iconic Branding

description.content: Iconic brands, that consumers can't help but fall in love with and pay a premium for, are one of the biggest drivers of shareholder value. Iconic brands are a repository of not only functional characteristics but also meaning and value. We help CMOs and their teams craft iconic brand positioning and deploy them brilliantly.

heading: Some of the tools we use to craft iconic brands are given below:

consulting.content: Consumer, social, and environmental insight mining
Understanding consumers functional, emotional, and social needs
Mapping competitor brands and identifying unmet needs
Crafting, identifying, and nurturing distinctive brand assets
Creating inspiring communication and design briefs
Deploying brand communication brilliantly in the market
Raising the ceiling of creative effectiveness

title: Agile Innovation

description.content: Innovations are essential to any organization and catalyze growth. However, over 90% of innovations fail. We work with organizations, using agile innovation methodologies, to take the ‘luck out of innovation’ and dramatically increase the odds of success.

heading: Agile innovation puts the consumer at the heart of the innovation process and helps deliver superior solutions faster and more effectively than ever before. Key elements of agile innovation include

consulting.content: Creating a category and innovation strategy
Ideation that delivers on consumer jobs
Listening to and learning from consumer feedback
Establishing a consumer-centric, agile innovation system and culture
